bot.guide:
Same as the Telegram Bot API, just with this address:
{api}/bot<token>/METHOD_NAME

Supports getMe, getUpdates, setWebhook, deleteWebhook, getWebhookInfo, sendMessage, sendPhoto, editMessageText, editMessageReplyMarkup, deleteMessage, answerCallbackQuery, setMyCommands, getChat, getFile and more. Buttons: inline_keyboard only (url / callback_data). chat_id: the user id for direct messages, negative for groups and channels. A user must message the bot first before the bot can message them directly.

Python (python-telegram-bot): set base_url to {api}/bot and base_file_url to {api}/file/bot
Node.js (Telegraf): set telegram.apiRoot to {api}

Webhooks need a public https address. With secret_token set, every update carries the X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header.

agreement.userBody:
Welcome to {app} (the "Platform"). Please read this Agreement carefully before using the Platform. By using the Platform, you agree to the following terms.

1. Age restriction
The Platform is intended only for adults aged 18 or older. By registering for or using the Platform, you confirm that you are at least 18 years old. If a user is found to be under 18, the Platform may immediately terminate the service and delete the account.

2. Account rules
(1) The Platform uses a one-account-per-device policy. Your account is automatically bound to your device, and no password is required.
(2) The gender selected at registration cannot be changed. Please provide it truthfully.
(3) Your account is for your personal use only and may not be sold, rented or transferred.

3. Code of conduct
When using the Platform, you agree not to post or spread any of the following:
(1) Content that violates laws or regulations;
(2) Pornographic, gambling, violent or terrorist content;
(3) Content that harasses, insults or defames others;
(4) Fraud, false advertising or spam.
If you violate these rules, the Platform may remove the content, restrict features or permanently ban the account.

4. Points
(1) Platform points are virtual items that can only be spent within the Platform (messages, calls, gifts, orders, etc.).
(2) Points cannot be exchanged for legal currency, and the Platform does not provide any form of cash-out service.
(3) Points in accounts banned for violations will not be refunded.

5. Safety at offline meetings
When meeting in person through a Platform order, please look after your own safety and choose a public place. The Platform only matches information and is not responsible for offline conduct. In case of a dispute, you may apply for arbitration through the Platform.

6. Responsibility for content
You are responsible for the posts, comments, messages and other content you publish on the Platform. The Platform may deal with content that violates the rules and cooperate with investigations by regulatory authorities.

7. Changes to and termination of services
The Platform may change, suspend or terminate some or all of its services as operations require. Major changes will be announced in advance.

8. Changes to this Agreement
The Platform may revise this Agreement from time to time. The revised Agreement takes effect once published on the Platform. Continued use means you accept the changes.
